results.title: Cristiano Ronaldo drops huge retirement hint following 2026 World Cup disappointment
results.description: Legendary forward Cristiano Ronaldo says that this is likely to be his final season as a professional footballer.

Amador and Sullivan hit 3-run HRs to help Rockies beat Giants 13-7
results.description: Adael Amador and Brett Sullivan each hit a three-run home run to help the Colorado Rockies beat the San Francisco Giants 13-7

results.title: Bruno Damiani scores twice in second half to rally Union to 3-2 victory over NYCFC
results.description: Bruno Damiani scored his first two goals of the season, 16-year-old Cavan Sullivan had two assists and the Philadelphia Union rallied from two goals down to beat New York City FC 3-2 at Yankee Stadium

results.title: Martinez's finger pushes Juventus towards an alternative deal from the Premier League
results.description: Juventus fear a repeat of the World Cup nightmare Juventus have settled their goalkeeping situation from an unexpected angle, switching their focus from Argentina's Emiliano Martinez to Tottenham's Guglielmo Vicario in a loan deal with a purchase clause.
